There doesn't seem to be a whole lot coming out this week. No Secret Wars (at least main series), no Spider-man, no Transformers. So nothing for me.

(Heck, not even series which I don't currently collect, but might in the future, Batman and Savage Dragon.)

Alright:

Black Canary # 2 - Loved issue 1. It caught me by surprise but considering how much I am enjoying the new Batgirl, it should not have. If you enjoy Batgirl, give Black Canary a spin. Also, keep an eye out for her band posters around the DCU.

Doomed # 2 - I generally hate Lobdell's writing. So. many. words. So imagine my slight self loathing when I enjoyed issue one. I don't have high hopes that this series will stick around especially if it veers into classic Lobdell but I'll stick with it until then.

Dr. Fate # 2 - I love Dr. Fate as a character. This is an interesting take on him and I'm digging the art style.

Green Lantern: The Lost Army # 2 - I'm just glad the crossovers have stopped. For now.

Harley Quinn # 18 - A big reason for DC willing to take chances on style differences. Just for that I'll keep buying.

Justice League # 42 - Dat Jason Fabok art.

Martian Manhunter # 2 - Didn't really dig the first issue but I'll give it some time to develop.

Robin: Son of Batman # 2 - They set up an interesting premise. Also, so many Robin things coming with the crossovers and the weeklies. Gotta read them all!

Secret Six # 4 - Considering how good issue 3 was, I am willing to put up with the delays on this title. Hopefully tomorrow is not one of them.

Superman/Wonder Woman #19 - Yeah, I'm interested in how this is gonna play out.
